_about: Group chats that talk (groupchat.py). Each burst is a little conversation between the people in one of your group chats (chat: crew, team or family). Roles: A, B, C are people in the chat (your crew or teammates); in the family chat P and Q are your parents, S and T your siblings. {A} etc. are their first names, {me} yours, {opp} the other team, {team} your team, {pet} your pet. lines arrive one at a time; you can jump in with one of `you` (say, then what they say back, fx: role -> {affection: n} is how they feel about you, me -> {fun, stress, mood}, crew -> {cohesion}, parents -> {trust}). side is someone DMing you after (only after the `you` options listed in after, or any).
